heading: Is Waffle-cones gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Waffle-cones and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Waffle cones typically contain wheat flour, which poses a significant gluten risk for individuals with coeliac disease. Cross-contamination during preparation is also a concern.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Waffle-cones can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.
